annotations.title: List tracked bets and their results

description: Hobby+ endpoint. Lists the bets registered with propline_track_bets, newest first, each with status (open / settled / expired), result, payout, profit and legs. Pass bet_id for one bet. status filters; since (ISO timestamp) returns only bets settled or regraded at or after it. 'open' means the game is not graded yet: say so, do not guess. 'expired' means the game was never graded within 14 days. regraded_at is set when an official stat correction changed a result.
name: propline_list_tracked_bets
title: List tracked bets and their results
